versions.subject: feat: Add rule for malicious CSR export on Exchange
versions.detection:
export_command:
    - 'New-ExchangeCertificate'
    - ' -GenerateRequest'
    - ' -BinaryEncoded'
    - ' -RequestFile'
export_params:
    - '\\\\localhost\\C$'
    - '\\\\127.0.0.1\\C$'
    - 'C:\\inetpub'
    - '.aspx'
condition: all of export_command and export_params
versions.spl: "New-ExchangeCertificate" OR " -GenerateRequest" OR " -BinaryEncoded" OR " -RequestFile" "\\\\localhost\\C$" OR "\\\\127.0.0.1\\C$" OR "C:\\inetpub" OR ".aspx"
